narration: In the data preparation stage, reference frames and replacement objects are extracted alongside bounding boxes and augmented 3D hand meshes.
The reference image is processed by a frozen VAE encoder into the Reference U-Net to extract multi-scale visual features.
Bounding box layout guidance is encoded and combined with Gaussian noise to provide spatial conditioning for generation.
ControlNet extracts structural pose constraints from the 3D hand mesh sequence and feeds them into the denoising backbone.
The Denoising U-Net fuses all conditioning via specialized attention layers, decoded into realistic video frames by the frozen VAE.
Finally, the HOI Restoration Module utilizes dedicated memory banks and spatial masks to restore intricate hand and object textures.
